summary.text: Judy H. Little is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Dave Craven (R).
She was the Democratic nominee for North Carolina House District 55 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Judy H. Little's Ballotpedia profile lists West Stanly High School as her education.
She ran unsuccessfully for Wadesboro Town Council in 2019, finishing fourth in a field of five candidates for two seats.
In 2024 she was the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 55, where incumbent Mark Brody (R) defeated her 63.0% to 37.0%.
She is on the 2026 general election ballot for the state senate seat.
